quote: If there is doubt, there is no doubt.
author: Sachin Bansal

quote: Always hire people who are smarter than you.
author: Sachin Bansal

quote: Never hire someone to do your initial sales. In fact you should acquire your first hundred customers yourself.
author: Shashank ND

quote: I strongly believe all students should have a startup during college. Doesn't matter if successful or how big or small. Worst case scenario it will make them 10x better employee than someone with no exposure to how a business works.
author: Kunal Shah

quote: If you fully accept the worst that can ever happen in your journey, fear won’t ever be an obstacle in starting-up.
author: Kunal Shah

quote: Raise money from investors who are more excited about the BUSINESS or MARKET than the TEAM. They can help discover amazing opportunities.
author: Abhishek Goyal

quote: Don’t be a jerk! Even if you are brilliant, don’t be a brilliant jerk.
author: Girish Mathrubootham

quote: There is no secret ingredient. To make something special you just have to believe it's special.
author: Rahul Yadav

quote: It's a long long road. Sometimes all you need are people who pat your back and say, carry on. Thank you to everyone who encourages.
author: Shradha Sharma

quote: Building predictability on top of market place economy is how new age businesses will get built.
author: Ritesh Agarwal

quote: It is extremely important to build something that a 100 people absolutely love using rather than making something that a 1000 people would just, kind of, like.
author: Ritesh Agarwal

quote: Many countries recover from crises. If India faces a bubble, it will be good and build resilience.
author: Ritesh Agarwal

quote: Economic incentives are not enough to retain the best employees – it’s about culture and team spirit.
author: Kunal Bahl

quote: If you want to walk fast, walk alone. But if you want to walk far, walk together.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: However big or small, make it a good business, make it a clean business, make it a business you are very proud of.
author: Deep Kalra

quote: It is important to achieve our goals, but not at any cost.
author: Mukesh Ambani

quote: If people are not laughing at your goals, your goals are too small.
author: Azim Premji

quote: Leadership is the self-confidence of working with people smarter than you.
author: Azim Premji

quote: Whether ecommerce companies make money or not, these logistics companies make revenue which is guaranteed for them by ecommerce transactions.
author: Arvind Singhal

quote: The trade market is the place with the least scope for emotions, especially of fear and greed.
author: Rachit Chawla

quote: Human capital is the most precious of all forms of capital available.
author: Ajay Ramasubramaniam

quote: The challenge we face is in talent – it takes bandwidth and time to get talent and build a team.
author: Bhavish Aggarwal

quote: Performance leads to recognition. Recognition brings respect. Respect enhances power.
author: Narayan Murthy

quote: The appetite of a horse is different from that of an elephant.
author: Radhika Agarwal

quote: Love your job, but never fall in love with your company.
author: Narayan Murthy

quote: If you can be stable and balanced in turbulent times, you will make a great leader. To infuse this sense of stability and balance in those around you and inspire a generation of leaders, you need insight.
author: Sadhguru

quote: We must distinguish between plan and purpose. Plan is a tool to fulfil the purpose. If you have an inclusive, burning purpose in your heart, a dozen plans will come up. As business leadership becomes more significant, they must move from profit to purpose.
author: Sadhguru

quote: At the end of the day, your business is a bunch of people together and how those people feel together is what matters.
author: Nithin Kamath

quote: Give more to earn more. You can’t think, “I’ll only grow. That supply chain or consumer can suffer. If everybody is happy, you will grow.”
author: Dr RS Sodhi

quote: I don't believe in taking right decisions, I take decisions and make them right.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: In any business, you need to have an edge over your competition. If something can be copied too easily, it will be copied eventually.
author: Nithin Kamath

quote: Building a company is similar to building a product. Culture is the UX for employees & Support is the UX for customers.
author: Girish Mathrubootham

quote: When hiring, it’s more about the energy the person leaves behind — more than the skillsets actually. I’ve spent 30 minutes with this guy, at the end of the 30 minutes, am I happy?
author: Nithin Kamath

quote: Value for many, value for money is our company’s business objective from the start.
author: Dr RS Sodhi

quote: Things that are very important for business. First, excellence in whatever you do. Second, punctuality and discipline.
author: Dr RS Sodhi

quote: When I became an entrepreneur, it was easier to find a work-life balance because then I was my own boss.
author: Sunita Maheshwari

quote: You have to learn and to learn, you must have humility. Unfortunately, there are too many people who think, ‘I know it all’. Nobody knows it all. Everybody has to be in a learning mode no matter how high you are.
author: Dr Pawan Goenka

quote: The biggest risk in business is not taking any risk at all.
author: Kunal Shah

quote: The day you stop enjoying what you do is the day you should stop doing it.
author: Deepak Parekh

quote: Great companies are built by great teams - there are no exceptions.
author: Harsh Mariwala

quote: Profitability is sustainability. No business can run forever on investor money.
author: Ashneer Grover

quote: Never sell yourself to a notion. Never sell you to a relationship. You have to be true for yourself
author: Abhijita Kulshreshta

quote: An amazing team, a vibrant community and a goal worth chasing giving every Indian woman a dream of the career of her choice, that is our mantra.
author: Sairee Chahal

quote: You women entrepreneurs out there, blaze new paths and don’t allow yourself to be restricted by outdated traditions.
author: Lisa Srao

quote: Today I see a billion people as a billion potential consumers, an opportunity to generate value for them and to make a return for myself.
author: Mukesh Ambani

quote: Entrepreneurship is akin to riding a dragon - there are more ups and downs than you can ever imagine. But every challenge on the way only makes you stronger, and every failure only bears new learnings.
author: Yatin Hans

quote: The biggest myth is that Indians want old ways of doing things. We have been shocked by how fast digital payment took off.
author: Vijay Shekhar Sharma

quote: You can be a business that lets the product do the talking, and thinks about giving back. A conscious business. I think India needs that. India needs a lot of big businesses, which are conscious about what is happening around them.
author: Nithin Kamath

quote: Don’t ever let somebody tell you, you can’t do something.
author: Vedika Goel

quote: When someone says you won’t do this because you are a girl, I can’t rest until I do that.
author: Aditi Chaurasia

quote: We need to eradicate poverty and generate employment and all this can be easily achieved through education. We all need to put in a little for the nation building- a nation we are proud of.
author: Kiran Majumdar Shaw

quote: Being able to fulfill a certain need is most gratifying. That thousand of women in India have found a respectable way of making their intimate choices of gratifying feeling.
author: Richa Kar

quote: I think more businessmen should be more conscious about what is happening around them. There is a concentration of wealth on the planet. That’s accelerating; it’s not going to change. But I think wherever there is a concentration, people should do more to give back.
author: Nithin Kamath

quote: The consumer should have blind faith in your brand. The customer should know, ‘This brand will never cheat me. This brand is for me. I own it.’
author: Dr RS Sodhi

quote: Entrepreneurship will take you to the darkest depths of despair. It gut-wrenching, but remember that you signed up for it, so go ahead and enjoy it. Stop being serious, enjoy the moments and highs and lows. When dark days come, smile through those as well.
author: Naiyya Saggi

quote: Women can do anything they believe in, they just have to believe in themselves.
author: Kanika Tekriwal

quote: Keep a long-term focus control your anxiety, and play on your strengths.
author: Ameera Shah

quote: Make a dreaming mandatory. Let the girls have ambition. That’s a start.
author: Suchi Mukherjee

quote: Trust yourself with your dreams castles are not built overnight.
author: Daisy Tanwani

quote: Nothing will work unless you do.
author: Upasana Taku

quote: Don’t give up on something just because you think you can’t do it.
author: Chanda Kochhar

quote: Focus on the problem you're solving, not on the money you'll make.
author: Ankur Warikoo

quote: In entrepreneurship, there is no failure - only learning.
author: Ronnie Screwvala

quote: The best way to go ahead in business is to create a value proposition that is unbeatable, and not to say that someone needs to be able to help me for me to do that.
author: Dr Pawan Goenka

quote: For good things to happen, wanting it is not enough. You have to deserve it — no matter who you are, what you do, where you are from. If you don’t deserve it, even if you get it, it will not be sustainable.
author: Dr Pawan Goenka

quote: If people respect you because they believe that you’re the kind of person they want to be led by, you’re the kind of person who will be there when they need you, that will make a huge difference.
author: Dr Pawan Goenka

quote: The first rule of any technology used in a business is that automation applied to an efficient operation will magnify the efficiency.
author: Sanjeev Bikhchandani

quote: Build for India, but design for the world.
author: Sridhar Vembu

quote: Customer experience is not just one department's job - it's everyone's job.
author: Ashish Shah

quote: Innovation happens at intersections. The more diverse your team, the more innovative your solutions.
author: Vineeta Singh

quote: Startups that solve problems for the top 1% eventually end up creating ripples for the remaining 99%.
author: Kunal Shah

quote: The journey is more important than the destination. Every failure brings you closer to success.
author: Binny Bansal

quote: The goal has never been about being an entrepreneur or starting a company. It has always been about solving a problem we deeply care about.
author: Shashank ND

quote: Entrepreneurship is all about how confident you are in changing something, because most of the people will not accept that change so go ahead and learn it.
author: Naveen Tiwari

quote: Be so sharp that you cut
author: Vijay Shekhar Sharma

quote: Scale is important for a startup. Think big, but take one day at a time.
author: Kunal Bahl

quote: The fundamental model of our business is that in mature markets we should make profits and they shouldn’t need any more outside money to grow.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: The first rule of entrepreneurship is that there is no rule.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: Everything is solvable, you have to put your mind to it.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: Being an entrepreneur is a tough job. You are the Chief Operating Officer and Chief Plumbing Officer.
author: Arun Jagannathan

quote: Focus on building business that solves a real problem.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: You can't say that if I don't have access to capital, I can't build a company.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: Value your gut - when your gut feels like something is wrong, think hard about it, and don't let data take over that decision.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: Hire good people. If you get good people, you don't have to manage them.
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: Execution is highly underrated. All the big things (strategy) are a sum total of small things (execution).
author: Deepinder Goyal

quote: How do you kill a company? By hiring the wrong leadership!
author: Anupam Mittal

quote: Sell your vision, not just the product.
author: Sanjay Anandaram

quote: Businesses should not be built on model or channel but rather out of a problem or passion.
author: Peyush Bansal

quote: One should accept failure, and be willing to learn, unlearn and relearn again.
author: Ritesh Agarwal

quote: One of the biggest hurdles in the path of entrepreneurship is home loans!
author: Vishwas Mudagal

quote: I don't believe in work-life balance. I believe in work-life integration. Make your work and life meaningful and fulfilling, and they will complement each other.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: Years of experience does not matter, what matters most is experience per year.
author: Amit Jain

quote: My definition of success is how I have the freedom and ability to do anything I want, without the fear of failure.
author: Vineeta Singh

quote: When something becomes a business, 50% of your decisions are what you have to do and not what you want to do.
author: Ronnie Screwvala

quote: When you hire people smarter than you, there's dissent, which is very important culture for creativity and innovation in any company.
author: Namita Thapar

quote: If you want to be a good developer, embrace the hacker culture, build, break, and tinker things for fun.
author: Kailash Nadh

quote: Don’t spend time with people who tell you everything is great. You learn more from people who disagree with you. Be that active listener.
author: Vani Kola

quote: Maintaining the right talent will become extra important for startups, and taking care of their mental and emotional wellbeing will be necessary.
author: Seema Rekha

quote: Turnover is vanity; profit is sanity; cash is reality.
author: Saumil Majmudar

quote: Don't wait for opportunities to come to you, create your own opportunities.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: Leadership is about taking responsibility, not making excuses.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: Never underestimate the power of kindness, empathy, and compassion in your interactions with others.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: The best leaders are those most interested in surrounding themselves with assistants and associates smarter than they are.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: The biggest risk is not taking any risk. In a world that is changing quickly, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risks.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: Power and wealth are not two of my main stakes.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: Be persistent and resilient in the face of challenges, for they are the building blocks of success.
author: Ratan Tata

quote: To be an entrepreneur, you need three I's: idea, investment, and most importantly being idiot.
author: Ankit Garg
